title: Petition of D's, d/b/a King's Transport for a 120-day temporary license under the provisions of Chapter 159A, Section 5, of the General Laws, as amended, for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire in the Cities of Boston, Marlboro, Waltham, Watertown, Newton and Brookline; the Towns of Northboro, Sudbury, Wayland, Weston and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority.
